90: The Bride unwaveringly continues on her roaring rampage of revenge against the band of assassins who had tried to kill her and her unborn child. She visits each of her former associates one-by-one, checking off the victims on her Death List Five until there's nothing left to do … but kill Bill.
The bride is back for the final cut.
Beatrix Kiddo / The Bride / 'Black Mamba' / Mommy
346: In early 20th-century Montana, Col. William Ludlow lives on a ranch in the wilderness with his sons, Alfred, Tristan, and Samuel. After the Fall from Innocence the Legend begins.
602: In the midst of trying to legitimize his business dealings in 1979 New York and Italy, aging mafia don, Michael Corleone seeks forgiveness for his sins while taking a young protege under his wing.
All the power on earth can't change destiny.
858: A slick New York publicist who picks up a ringing receiver in a phone booth is told that if he hangs up, he'll be killed... and the little red light from a laser rifle sight is proof that the caller isn't kidding.
No options. No lies. No fear. No deals. Just keep talking.
1114: After years of helping their hubbies climb the ladder of success, three mid-life Manhattanites have been dumped for a newer, curvier model. But the trio is determined to turn their pain into gain. They come up with a cleverly devious plan to hit their exes where it really hurts - in the wallet!

But her past holds many secrets—including Jake, the redneck husband she married in high school, who refuses to divorce her. Bound and determined to end their contentious relationship once and for all, Melanie sneaks back home to Alabama to confront her past.
Sometimes what you're looking for is right where you left it.

Life doesn't have to be perfect for love to be extraordinary.

First it takes hold of your mind...then it takes hold of your life.
Suicide Blonde / Mrs. Dobkins / Young Fingerling's Mother

Be bold. Be brave. Be prepared.

He took someone else's idea and America ate it up.
2650: Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire, to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adele grows, seeks herself, loses herself, finds herself.

A single shot can end the war.

Why are the world's chief assassins after Inspector Clouseau? Why not? Everybody else is.
3674: A packed cruise ship traveling the Atlantic is hit and overturned by a massive wave, compelling the passengers to begin a dramatic fight for their lives.
3930: Milly and Louis, and their recently-widowed mom, Charlene, move to a new neighborhood. A very special love. And a very special magic. But is it real magic or just an illusion?
4186: A tough-on-crime street cop must protect the only surviving witness to a strange murderous cult with far reaching plans.
Crime is a disease. Meet the cure.

He's got a lot on his mind.
5722: Bored with Bollywood movies but fascinated with their Hollywood counterparts from his youth, Ram dreams to become a singer and actor in America, the country where dreams are made. 5978: Throughout the late 19th-century and early 20th-century, Mr Arthur Chipping rises from a shy, nervous teacher to the beloved, revered headmaster of Brookfield School, with his life and career shaped by his love for his wife and his unwavering dedication to his students.
At The Top Of The Year's "Ten Best" - The picture that earns for 1939 a proud place in motion-picture history!
John Colley / Peter Colley I / Peter Colley II / Peter Colley III
Peter Colley as a Young Man
6234: After three years of therapy Charley Brewster, now a college student, is convinced that Jerry Dandridge was a serial killer posing as a vampire. Do you have a taste for terror? The suckers are back.
6490: A novelist's wife and son see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.
The true story of one man's terrifying journey into the unknown.

7002: Two teen girls, one from the city, one from the country, try to find the hidden gold of Bear Mountain learning about friendship, loyalty and courage on the way.
Some friendships are worth a fortune

There's more than one way to lose your heart...

Another con. Another sting. Another day.
8282: Bud Clay races motorcycles in the 250cc Formula II class of road racing. After a race in New Hampshire, he has five days to get to his next race in California. During his road trip, he is haunted by memories of the last time he saw Daisy, his true love.
8538: To prove a point about measuring up and fitting in, Texas teen Willowdean “Dumplin’” Dickson enters a local pageant run by her ex-beauty queen mom.
Find out who you are and do it on purpose

Mad As In Angry. Or Just Plain... NUTS

One shot is all it takes
9306: An elite Navy SEAL uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife.
From the author of Rainbow Six.

Why did Emily call Charlie the most immoral man she'd ever met?

THEY FOUGHT BEST WHEN IT WAS HOPELESS!

Going back is the only way forward.

A widower's religious devotion is put to a difficult test.
12634: Vignettes of the lives of several residents of a Vienna suburb during a heat wave.
Die geschiedene Frau und Freundin des Masseurs

Run, don't walk to see Walk, Don't Run.
13146: A grieving widower is drawn into a custody battle over his granddaughter, whom he helped raise her entire life.
There's more to family than what you see.
13402: When a foreign exchange student arrives in a small upstate New York town, she challenges the dynamics of her host family's relationships and alters their lives forever.
13658: Middle-aged university professor desperately tries to strike a balance in his life between his wife and his mistress, slowly getting bogged down in his own lies.
дядя Коля, сосед Аллы по коммунальной квартире
14170: Disturbing and mysterious things begin to happen to a bartender in New Orleans after he picks up a phone left behind at his bar.

15194: After being thrown out of her home, a young woman decides to disguise herself as a man to survive the ruthless Wild West.
In the Wild West, a woman had only two choices. She could be a wife or she could be a whore... Josephine Monaghan chose to be a man.
15450: A regular guy struggles with a repressive home and professional life, as well as making amends for the trouble his free-spirited brother and sister cause about town.

The creator of "Laura" does it again!

How do you catch a killer when he's holding all the cards?

At Last...The Stars You've Wanted - In Each Other's Arms!

17754: Former SWAT leader David Hendrix and hard-partying movie star Brody Walker must cut their ride-along short when a police training facility is attacked by a team of mercenaries.

It's bigger than all of us!

A man can be as strong as steel...but somewhere there's a woman who'll break him!

20314: A coroner finds a capsule in the head of a heavily mutilated corpse, containing a phone number and single word: the name of his daughter.
20570: In the late 19th century, a chambermaid from Paris relocates to a remote household in Provence, engages in trysts and finds herself enraptured with a coach driver.
20826: To save a girl in danger, a priest and deacon jump into a mysterious case.
21082: On a quiet street in Helsinki, Sachie has opened a diner featuring rice balls. For a month she has no customers. Then, in short order, she has her first customer, meets Midori, a gangly Japanese tourist, and invites her to stay with her.
Have a meal and go on a walk.
21338: Scamper is a little penguin who loves wandering around the Artic where he lives with his parents. Scamper, Snowflake and their new friend, a macaroni penguin named Louie, must escape and get back to their families to warn them.
This Penguin Marches to a Different Tune

22106: Maddy and Cole were inseparable friends until high school started and Maddy became the most popular girl on campus. When she starts feeling lonely and heartbroken, she reconnects with Cole and the duo conspire to destroy the ultimate teen popularity contest
22362: The story of a blind dervish named Bab'Aziz and his spirited granddaughter, Ishtar. Together they wander the desert in search of a great reunion of dervishes that takes place just once every thirty years. With faith as their only guide, the two journey for days through the expansive, barren landscape.
To find the beloved, one must have faith

Love can lead us where we least expect.

Sometimes the universe leaves you a message.
23898: A middle-class boy in Ahmedabad, Satyaprem falling in one-sided love with Katha, who is coping with her breakup with Tapan. Through the journey, they discover each other's life and complement in accomplishing what was left halfway.
24154: Parthenope, born in the sea near Naples in 1950, is beautiful, enigmatic, and intelligent. She is shamelessly courted by many. However, beauty comes at a cost.
Is she a siren or a myth?

Fear the past or face it.
24666: Helen is a nonconformist teenage girl who maintains a conflictual relationship with her parents. Hanging out most of her time with her friend Corinna, with whom she breaks one social taboo after another, she uses sex as a way to rebel and break the conventional bourgeois ethic. After an intimate shaving accident, Helen ends up in the hospital where it doesn’t take long before she makes waves. But there she finds Robin, a male nurse who will sweep her off her feet...

One murder is a crime. Two is a mystery.
25178: In 1917, two young music students attending the Boston Conservatory bond over a mutual love of folk music. They reconnect a few years later, embarking on a song-collecting trip in the backwaters of Maine.

Now, Patrick’s childhood tormentor has returned, threatening the safety of his wife Karina and son Jake.
He's always closer than you think.

Trapped at 30,000 feet, they will play for their lives and those of their families. They will discover the hard way that putting your life online can have dire consequences...
Have You Read The Terms & Conditions?
25946: Two adorable kids, a quirky mother-in-law and a happy-go-lucky friend help a heartbroken wife bring a straying husband back from the other woman's tangled embrace.
26202: An agoraphobic hip-hop prodigy and a disgraced former music manager cross paths in Chicago’s South Side and help each other face demons of their pasts.
26458: In dire need of money, Jerry gets drawn into the dangerous world of drug trafficking. Things go awry when she decides to quit.
26714: 14-year-old basketball phenom Terron Forte has to navigate the under-the-table world of amateur athletics when he is recruited to an elite NCAA prep school.
26970: After losing the love of his life to a cruel Philistine prince, a young Hebrew with Supernatural strength defends his people, sacrificing everything to avenge his love, his people, and his God.
27226: Runaway heiress in search of her beloved falls in love with another man on the way.
27482: When a flyover in the city becomes the hotbed of accidents, a young reporter decides to investigate the issue. Her quest for an answer would lead her into a web of intrigue, murder and mystery.
27994: A family must come to grips with its culture, its faith, and the brutal political changes entering its small-town world.

He has no choice but to reopen his agency with his former accomplices for an ultimate Alibi and to find more presentable fake parents.
28762: After a rocky start, a friendship develops between a happy-go-lucky youth and a girl from the city.
29018: After losing their respective nest eggs thanks to a bumbling bank employee, three men use him to plot a bold and batty heist to get their money back.

29530: In an effort to land the guy she's been pining after since grade school, Abby hires a local stripper named Santa Monica to teach her everything she needs to know about confidence and sex.
To get the guy, she'll need the right teacher.

Five great stars in a masterpiece of bold and intimate emotions !
30042: An underprivileged, gifted young black man from Newark reaches Yale University, only for shadows and injustices from his past to threaten his future.

Who she was. Who she is.

30810: Hatem is a corrupt police officer, who loves his neighbor Nour, who in turn loves the prosecutor, Sherif. Hatem tries to win Nour’s attention even if by force.
31066: Thoracic surgeon Evgenia Belyaeva has one month to prepare for a flight to the International Space Station, where she must operate on a crew member. Will she be up for the challenge? Can she overcome her fears and insecurities? Will she be able to perform the complicated surgery in zero gravity, and give the cosmonaut a chance to return to Earth alive?
31322: The story of a hitman who kills for the mob, but on one job he falls madly in love with a girl, who happens to be the beautiful daughter of an associate.
31578: Super (Kannada: ಸೂಪರ್) (originally known only by Vitarka Mudrā hand symbol) is a 2010 Indian multilingual film written and directed by Upendra. With the title of the film depicted only by a symbol, it features Upendra and Nayantara in lead roles and is produced by Rockline Venkatesh, while V. Harikrishna has scored the music. Raking in more than Rs 100 million through satellite television and audio rights even before release, it was declared a superhit in Kannada where it grossed a record Rs 25 million in first three days of the opening weekend. The film grossed over 50 crore (US$9.05 million) and has been declared one of the biggest blockbusters of Kannada cinema.
31834: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.
32346: Two young sisters find that all the mirrors in their estranged aunt's house are covered or hidden. When one of them happens upon a mirror in the basement, she unknowingly releases a malicious demon.

On Board Flight 502 Is A Bomb. It Could Be Anywhere. And A Skyjacker. It Could Be Anyone.

A handful of condemned men on an impossible mission, against hopeless odds...
33114: Sam, a freelance journalist, decides to investigate the growing phenomenon of disaffected youth joining extremist groups. He infiltrates a group of four young people who have been tasked with the creation of a jihadist cell and whose mission is to destabilise the city centre of Paris.

Armed for war and out for justice.
